Description: Susceptible individuals become exposed to the virus at rate λ(t).
Exposed individuals transition from the first to the second exposed sub-compartment at rate σ.
Exposed individuals in the second sub-compartment become infectious at rate σ.
Infectious individuals transition from the first to the second infectious sub-compartment at rate γ.
Infectious individuals in the second sub-compartment recover at rate γ.

Name: π
Description: The proportion of the population who is initially susceptible.

Name: λ_0
Description: The initial infection rate at the start of the epidemic.

Name: ψ
Description: The Exponential Growth Rate (EGR) at the start of the epidemic.

Name: η
Description: The over-dispersion parameter for the Negative Binomial observation model.

Name: p_ICU
Description: The probability of being admitted to ICU given infection.

Name: γ
Description: The daily rate of recovery (transition from Infectious to Removed).

Name: σ^2_ICU|E
Description: The variance of the time from infection to ICU admission.

Name: δt
Description: The length of the discrete time step used in the model.

Name: β
Description: The constant transmission rate, representing the rate at which new infections take place given a contact.
